claim: To set up a VPC connection for Amazon Quick Enterprise edition, you make sure that components work together to allow network traffic to pass between Amazon Quick and your data source; they include the subnets that your data source is using, the Amazon Quick elastic network interfaces and the subnets they use, and the security group attached to the Amazon Quick network interface.

evidence.quote: To set up a VPC to use with Amazon Quick Enterprise edition, you need access to Amazon VPC and Amazon EC2.
To set up a successful VPC connection, make sure that the following components work together to allow network traffic to pass between Amazon Quick and your data source:
The subnets that your data source is using
The Amazon Quick elastic network interfaces and the subnets they use
Security group attached to the Amazon Quick network interface.
